findings.current: My internal energy had increased noticeably, even if not by a huge amount.
findings.defect: The draft says the increase was noticeable; the source says it was not visibly apparent, though he could immediately feel it.
findings.rationale: 눈에 띌 만큼은 아니어도 contrasts outward visibility with Taekyung’s immediate perception.
findings.replacement: The increase in my internal energy wasn’t visible, but I could feel it at once.
findings.source: 눈에 띌 만큼은 아니어도 확실히 증가한 공력이 대번에 느껴졌다.

findings.defect: Taekyung withholds the information; he does not say Mujin lacks the ability to understand it.
findings.rationale: 몰라도 돼 means it is fine for Mujin not to know.
findings.replacement: “You don’t need to know. It’s just something.”
findings.source: 넌 몰라도 돼. 그냥 그런 게 있어.

findings.current: *“Give them a proper funeral and watch them on their final journey. But whoever the patient may be, always remember one thing.”*
findings.defect: A funeral replaces the specific act of carefully preparing the deceased’s body.
findings.rationale: 염해 주고 names preparation of the body; it does not say to hold a funeral.
findings.replacement: *“Carefully prepare their body for burial, and see them off on their final journey. But whoever the patient may be, always remember one thing.”*
findings.source: 정성을 다해 염(鹽)해 주고, 떠나는 길을 지켜보아라.

summary: Three actionable fidelity issues: a reversed observation about internal energy, a changed conversational cue, and a funeral substituted for preparing the body.
